items.title: China luxury sales plunge: top 25 labels down over 10% in July
items.summary: Sales at China's 25 biggest luxury labels fell more than 10% in July, a steeper drop than June. Louis Vuitton, Dior, Gucci, Bottega Veneta and Balenciaga all posted double-digit declines; Hermes swung from growth to decline; Chanel and Prada growth decelerated sharply. Analysts cite tighter capital controls, offshore-asset tax enforcement, and cautious VIP clients amid a falling MSCI China Index.

items.title: Kering stock reacts to China luxury slowdown as investors weigh Gucci
items.summary: Kering shares fell 3.6% alongside other European luxury peers as fresh data showed sharp deceleration in Chinese high-end spending. Gucci, the group's flagship revenue driver, is described as showing 'improving trends through the quarter' but still exposed to China weakness; analysts still forecast a Kering return to sales growth by Q4 2026.

items.source: Lux Research Japan (weekly luxury market report)
items.title: Luxury Market Weekly Report Vol.5: Gucci contraction narrows to -2%
items.summary: Independent luxury-market research newsletter notes Gucci's H1 2026 organic sales remain in contraction at -2%, a meaningful improvement from -8% the prior quarter, framed as part of Kering 'turning the corner' though recovery is still gradual.

items.title: 중고시장 뜨는데 중고 명품은 외면...신뢰 잃은 '럭셔리 리셀'의 추락
items.summary: Korean secondhand-luxury resale platforms are collapsing even as general secondhand commerce grows; pioneer platform Mustit posted a KRW 7.8bn operating loss with revenue down 52.2% YoY. Piece cites fatigue with markup-driven resale, counterfeit concerns and eroding brand trust as consumers shift toward mint-condition boutiques instead, implicitly covering Gucci as a heavily-resold brand alongside peers.

items.title: グッチがアルピーヌと共にF1へ参入 初のラグジュアリーファッションがタイトルパートナーに
items.summary: Background reference: Gucci becomes Alpine's F1 title partner from 2027 as 'Gucci Racing Alpine Formula One Team,' the first luxury fashion house to hold a title-partner role in F1. Included for context on Gucci's brand-building push outside core fashion; item is dated, retained only as background since no fresher NEA-language coverage or reaction was found this cycle.

items.source: PR TIMES / Kering Japan press release
items.title: デムナによる新生グッチ「La Famiglia」着想の短編映画「The Tiger」プレミア開催
items.summary: Kering Japan press release announces a Tokyo premiere event for 'The Tiger,' a short film inspired by Demna's 'La Famiglia' Gucci campaign, ahead of the collection's Japan retail rollout September 25-October 13. Official activation coverage; flagged as brand-marketing rather than independent public opinion.

items.title: 중고명품 가격 30~40% 갈리는 이유 - 실전 팁 스레드
items.summary: Korean reseller/community Threads post explaining that secondhand luxury (implicitly including Gucci) prices vary 30-40% by condition grade and completeness, advising buyers to verify recent resale comps and use platform inspection/escrow; reflects grassroots consumer distrust and price-sensitivity themes around luxury resale rather than brand-specific news.

items.title: 명품 리셀 안 되는 이유는 매입처 문제라는 실무자 코멘트
items.summary: Secondhand-luxury trade practitioner argues on Threads that resale margin pressure (including for brands like Gucci) is driven by inflated domestic wholesale buy-in prices rather than a fundamentally shrinking resale market, pushing back somewhat on 'luxury resale is dead' narratives seen elsewhere in the pool.

items.title: 명품 갤러리: 구찌 정품 감정/품질 논쟁 스레드 지속
items.summary: Korea's largest anonymous-forum luxury board (명품 갤러리) continues recurring threads debating Gucci product authentication, leather/hardware quality complaints, and counterfeit ('레플리카') comparisons; represents baseline community chatter rather than a single news event, admitted as community-channel signal per channel-mix requirement.
